answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the canyon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The pearl holds work receipts rather than names, so the jetty of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
